answer: Require each agent identity to lock a bond and build a reputation anchor over epochs before its votes count fully. New identities start with low weight and must pass a liveness pulse: original, peer-graded work every epoch. An admission gate checks that work for duplicates and links to past identities before granting full standing, like a wharf berthing only verified ships. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 bonds, produce 1,000 graded works each epoch, and risk slashing all bonds if caught copying. Cost grows linearly per fake, while one honest agent pays once.
